project_context: E-commerce (catalog/storefront) + Admin Dashboard for 3D Printing (PLA). Language: pt-BR. Currency: R$.

typography.hierarchy_rules: Headings must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter. Overlines/labels must be Uppercase + Tiny + tracking-[0.2em]. Line height tight (leading-none) for headers, loose (leading-relaxed) for body. Do not exceed text-6xl for hero.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the layout skeleton using border-collapse style layouts. Items should have border-r border-b border-border/40. No heavy drop shadows. Keep interfaces minimal and technical.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Explicit text color changes on hover. Surfaces slightly lift (-translate-y-1) with subtle border color lightening. Focus states must have higher contrast.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle grain/noise overlays (opacity 0.02 to 0.04) to large dark backgrounds to eliminate 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or floating navs: use bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and a 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10). DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds over content.

components.buttons: Sharp rectangular or slightly rounded (max rounded-md). 1px solid borders. Accent colors used VERY sparingly (only for primary 'Solicitar Orçamento' or 'Publicar' actions).
components.cards: Go cardless or use dense, flat rectangular styles with subtle 1px borders and no shadow. Max 4px border-radius.
components.forms: Use customized Shadcn components. Inputs should have deep dark backgrounds (bg-[#0A0B0F]), subtle borders. Never use native raw inputs.
components.tables: Dense rows, technical font (IBM Plex Sans), subtle borders for the admin dashboard.
components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular) for a technical, high-end hardware aesthetic. Do NOT use emojis.

grids_and_layouts.homepage: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A). Asymmetric, visual tension. 1-8-12 column layouts with wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Leave 'breathing room'.
grids_and_layouts.catalog_and_dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, or p-16 for containers. Components with borders MUST have internal padding to prevent collision.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content and forms. Avoid center-everything disease.

motion.interactions: Micro-animations for feedback. Hover states, active/press states (scale-95).
motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform). NEVER use 'transition: all'.
motion.loading: Use minimalist skeleton loaders or subtle ASCII-style/technical spinners instead of generic circular ones.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards. Normal text min 4.5:1 ratio. Large text min 3:1.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent_discreet focus:outline-none) on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='product-card-1').

hero_minimal_3d.description: Floating geometric cubes and glowing spheres, minimal. Perfect for the homepage hero background.

catalog_pla_spool.description: Spool of orange PLA on a 3D printer. Good for 'Material' section or category headers.

admin_tech_bg.description: Dark tech workspace. Excellent for Admin login background.

media.style: Hero images must have a max overlay opacity of bg-black/50 or bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80 to-transparent to ensure text contrast without killing the image. Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for smooth UI transitions and image galleries. No heavy WebGL/Three.js required unless explicitly needed for 3D model viewing in the product page. If needed, use @react-three/fiber.

instructions_to_main_agent: Target environment uses .js files, NOT .tsx. All Shadcn components and custom React code must be written in standard Javascript/JSX (.js or .jsx).
Implement pt-BR localization across the entire application (e.g., 'Solicitar Orçamento', 'Catálogo', 'Página Inicial').
Format all prices using BRL format: R$ 0,00.
Build standard raw HTML/Tailwind structures for the Marketing/Homepage to allow asymmetrical layouts. Do not force Shadcn 'Card' components into the hero section.
Use customized Shadcn components heavily in the Admin Dashboard and Product forms.
Implement a visible navigation bar with Logo, links, and primary CTA. Navigation must not be fully transparent.
All forms must use customized Shadcn Input, Select, and Form components. Do not use native HTML inputs.
Never use generic placeholders for images; use the provided URLs or design elegant CSS-only fallback patterns.
Ensure the application strictly uses the dark theme logic as default and only mode.
For the file structure, configure tailwind.config.js with the custom color palette.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Maintain consistent layout structures using Grid and Flexbox. Grid items must be direct children of the grid container.
All interactive elements must be accessible via keyboard navigation.
Use visual hierarchy to guide users to the primary CTA (Quote Request / Orçamento).
Group related information visually in the product specs (material, weight, dimensions).
Provide clear empty states for the catalog when filters yield no results.
Ensure touch targets are large enough (min 44x44px) on mobile views.
